article.title: Mexico City eliminates minimum parking requirements (bravo)
article.excerpt: The largest city in North America has done away with one of the biggest hidden subsidies for driving: minimum parking requirements. Mexico City eliminated requirements that force developers to build a minimum number of parking spaces in each project .
